title: Clowder AI Plugin Contract — Messaging Domain (v0.1)
description: Machine-readable truth source for messaging types (§3.1). Candidate — do not consume until published. Root schema validates that a document is one of the contract's top-level messaging types; use $defs/$ref for targeted single-type validation.

ElementKind.description: @candidate — v0 element kinds. text requires {text:string} payload.

payload.description: Kind-specific payload — shape varies by kind. text → {text:string}.

derivedFromElementId.description: Provenance chain — points to source element for augmentation. Host enforces epistemicStatus ceiling (INV-7).

epistemicStatus.description: @candidate — element-level epistemic override. Defaults to 'inference' if omitted. Declaring non-inference requires derivedFromElementId pointing to a source with same-or-higher status (INV-7 machine enforcement).

MessageDraft.description: A message draft submitted by a plugin via messaging.send(draft). Addressing uses host-signed handles only — no raw threadId channel (§3.1).

idempotencyKey.description: @candidate bound: idempotencyKey ≤ 200 chars. Client-generated; must be stable across retries/restarts. Ledger key = (pluginInstanceId, idempotencyKey).

sourceEventId.description: External source provenance — NOT the idempotency key.

MessageEnvelope.description: Canonical message produced by the host after accepting a draft. All identity fields are host-bound (§3.1).

occurredAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC only — must end with 'Z'. Timezone offsets (+HH:MM) are structurally rejected; timezone is a display concern, storage is always UTC.

operationId.description: Append idempotency key component. Ledger key = (pluginInstanceId, messageId, operationId).

MessageOutputEvent.description: An event in the per-thread output event stream (§3.1). eventId is deterministic (e.g., ev_pub_{msgId}_1 / ev_app_{msgId}_{opId}) — idempotent replay. Restricted content does not emit events → sequence may have visible gaps but monotonicity is never broken.

eventId.description: @candidate — deterministic, globally unique. Pattern: ev_pub_{msgId}_{revision} / ev_app_{msgId}_{opId}. Enables idempotent event replay.

sequence.description: Per-thread monotonic (host-assigned). Gaps are possible (restricted content skips) but monotonicity never breaks. Cursor is opaque and subscription-local — NOT equal to sequence.

SendReceipt.description: @candidate — receipt from messaging.send(draft). Whisper messages do not carry publishSequence (v0: whisper not in event stream, fail-closed).

publishSequence.description: @candidate — per-thread event sequence. Absent for whisper messages (v0: whisper not in event stream).

appendSequence.description: @candidate — per-thread event sequence for the append event.

appliedElementIds.description: Element IDs that were actually applied (server may filter duplicates).

MessagingErrorCode.description: @candidate — messaging domain error codes. RETRYABLE_INFLIGHT = send accepted but settlement pending (retry safe); STALE_CURSOR = subscription cursor behind window, need snapshot.

MessageHandle.description: Host-signed message handle — authorization token for appendElements (§3.3, G-0 件 2 注 2).

SubscriptionCursor.description: Opaque subscription cursor for durable ack-based delivery. NOT equal to sequence number (§3.1).

AppendElementsRequest.description: Request to append elements to an existing message (§3.3). Requires a MessageHandle and at least one element.

operationId.description: Append idempotency key. Ledger key = (pluginInstanceId, handle.messageId, operationId).

baseRevision.description: Optimistic concurrency guard — reject if stale.

IngressSourceAddress.description: External ingress source address, carried before canonical binding (§3.1). The Host Adapter resolves target thread and binds actor/provenance.

SubscriptionReadResponse.description: @candidate verb name 'read'. Response from subscription read — expresses empty read (events=[], ackToken=null), normal delivery (events+ackToken), and stale state (stale=true → snapshot needed). Proposal §3.1: cursor behind window = stale, not silent event loss.

events.description: Batch of output events. Empty array = no new events.

ackToken.description: Cursor to ack for durable delivery. null when no events available (empty read).

stale.description: true → subscription cursor has fallen behind the event window. Client must call snapshot to catch up (§3.1: stale does not silently drop events).

SnapshotResponse.description: @candidate verb name 'snapshot'. Full envelope snapshot for catch-up after stale cursor (§3.1). Provides current thread state and a sequence to resume from.

resumeSequence.description: Sequence number to resume subscription from after processing snapshot.
